'''Hoersch-Kessel Drive, Inc.''' ('''HKD'''), also known as '''Hoersch-Kessel Driveworks Inc.''', was one of the most successful [[Starship/Legends|starship]] design firms in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], and had the distinction of being wholly owned by [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] investors. when the company fell on hard times, it was sold off to a [[Nimban/Legends|Nimbanese]] clan, which dismantled many of the company's less profitable divisions. However, the quest to develop a leaner bottom line destroyed morale, driving many designers to work for other starship firms. The manufacturer remained in business despite a succession of owners over several centuries, although the company was a shadow of its former self. HKD then specialized in constructing [[Transport/Legends|supertransports]] and [[Container ship/Legends|container vessels]], producing fewer than one hundred ships per a standard year.<ref name="EG Vehicles and Vessels">''[[The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref>

==History==
Hoersch-Kessel Drive, Inc. was an influential business that was originally owned by members of the [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] [[Species/Legends|species]]<ref name="NEGVV">''[[The New Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref> and was in existence since at least around<ref name="TOTJC">''[[Tales of the Jedi Companion]]''</ref> [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]].<ref name="4000 BBY">''[[Tales of the Jedi Companion]]'' is set around 4,000 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] prior to the events of {{Film|IV}}, which corresponds to approximately [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]] per ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> Around that [[Time/Legends|time]], the company was facing financial difficulties and was fending off a buyout attempt by a group of [[Nimbanel/Legends|Nimbanese]].<ref name="TOTJC" />

Later it was secretly a subsidiary of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] and produced for it numerous vehicles, including the [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|''Lucrehulk''-class battleship]]. After the Trade Federation's defeat at the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]], the company was first sold to [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] investors<ref name="CSWE Hoersch">{{CSWECite|II|48|Hoersch-Kessel Drive, Incorporated}}</ref> and then, around the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="LoNH" /> to a Nimbanese clan<ref name="CSWE Hoersch" /> of businessmen and investors.<ref name="LoNH" />

Hoersch-Kessel Drive helped produce starships for the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] along with the [[Free Dac Volunteers Engineering Corps/Legends|Free Dac Volunteers Engineering Corps]], which included the [[Recusant-class light destroyer/Legends|''Recusant''-class light destroyer]] and the [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigate]] and even the [[R60 T-wing interceptor]].

In an attempt to make HKD more profitable, its Nimbanese owners closed down the corporation, shutting down hundreds of factories and entire design divisions. This drove many designers and engineers away from the corporation, further weakening the company. Ownership of HKD changed many times between the Clone Wars and the end of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

By the time of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], Hoersch-Kessel Drive had returned to its roots, producing transports and container ships, though it was still unprofitable and produced very few ships.
